post.title: In Memory of the Nine | Why We Rush to Explain Tragedy #shorts
post.description: On Nov 1, a Learjet 60 flying from Austin to the Bahamas came down in Greenacres, Florida. All nine people on board died. The crew had reported ice and turbulence at 35,000 ft; the NTSB is investigating and hasn't named a cause. Our thoughts are with every family grieving. Music: "Heartbreaking" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0. #psychology #needforclosure #shorts
